headline: Pori Moni gets bail after surrendering in assault case
summary: The actress faced allegations of snatching a journalist's phone and verbal abuse during a chaotic court appearance in Dhaka.
details: Actress Pori Moni surrendered to the Dhaka Chief Judicial Magistrate Court on Thursday and was granted bail on a Tk 500 bond.
The appearance was marked by chaos as Pori Moni's security guards allegedly pushed and jostled journalists trying to document the proceedings.
Reports indicate that Pori Moni snatched a mobile phone from Samakal multimedia reporter Robiul Hossain while he was recording a video.
A court visitor, Sujan Chandra Moni Das, sustained a head injury and was seen bleeding after being pushed by the actress's security guards.
After securing bail, Pori Moni allegedly verbally abused journalists and approached reporter Robiul Hossain aggressively before leaving the premises.
The case was originally filed by businessman Nasir Uddin Mahmud on July 6, 2022, involving allegations of assault, vandalism, and intimidation.
A PBI report submitted in March 2023 substantiated the allegations of assault and intimidation against Pori Moni and Junaid Bogdadi Jimmy.
caption:
Pori Moni gets bail on a Tk 500 bond, but her court appearance ends in chaos and allegations of assault.

Actress Pori Moni surrendered to the Dhaka Chief Judicial Magistrate Court on Thursday and was granted bail on a Tk 500 bond.

The appearance was marked by chaos as Pori Moni's security guards allegedly pushed and jostled journalists trying to document the proceedings.

Reports indicate that Pori Moni snatched a mobile phone from Samakal multimedia reporter Robiul Hossain while he was recording a video.

A court visitor, Sujan Chandra Moni Das, sustained a head injury and was seen bleeding after being pushed by the actress's security guards.

After securing bail, Pori Moni allegedly verbally abused journalists and approached reporter Robiul Hossain aggressively before leaving the premises.

The case was originally filed by businessman Nasir Uddin Mahmud on July 6, 2022, involving allegations of assault, vandalism, and intimidation.

A PBI report submitted in March 2023 substantiated the allegations of assault and intimidation against Pori Moni and Junaid Bogdadi Jimmy.

headline_marked: Tk 5,482 hike: [[Gold prices surge again]] in Bangladesh
headline: Tk 5,482 hike: Gold prices surge again in Bangladesh
summary: The price of 22-carat gold has reached Tk 229,664 per Bhori after three price increases in just four days.
details: The Bangladesh Jewellers' Association (BAJUS) has increased the rate of 22-carat gold by Tk 5,482 per Bhori, bringing the new price to Tk 229,664.
This marks the third price hike in four days, with previous increases occurring on November 2 and November 4.
Under the latest adjustment, 21-carat gold now costs Tk 219,341, 18-carat gold is Tk 188,374, and traditional gold is priced at Tk 153,848 per Bhori.
BAJUS attributed the latest price surge to a rise in the price of pure gold in the local market.
Historically, gold hit a record high of $5,591.61 per ounce in the international spot market on January 29, which pushed the local 22-carat rate to a record Tk 286,001 per Bhori.
Prices have since fluctuated, including a period of decline where rates fell below $4,000 an ounce on October 30.
caption:
Gold prices just jumped again. 22-carat gold now costs Tk 229,664 per Bhori after three hikes in four days.

The Bangladesh Jewellers' Association (BAJUS) has increased the rate of 22-carat gold by Tk 5,482 per Bhori, bringing the new price to Tk 229,664.

This marks the third price hike in four days, with previous increases occurring on November 2 and November 4.

Under the latest adjustment, 21-carat gold now costs Tk 219,341, 18-carat gold is Tk 188,374, and traditional gold is priced at Tk 153,848 per Bhori.

BAJUS attributed the latest price surge to a rise in the price of pure gold in the local market.

Historically, gold hit a record high of $5,591.61 per ounce in the international spot market on January 29, which pushed the local 22-carat rate to a record Tk 286,001 per Bhori.

Prices have since fluctuated, including a period of decline where rates fell below $4,000 an ounce on October 30.
